pages.text: Addendum for $(l:structures/alteration_site)$(c)$(o)Alteration Sites$().$(br)$(br)I find it to be such a shame that the majority of rituals are only every passed down through cults - mostly in their churches. That's the way I learned about most I know of, such as the Inhabiting or the Scorching Ritual. Rituals offer a fascinating insight into some of the inner workings of the Risus. For example, I was under the impression that Concentration Cores simply gathered and focused the memories stored in the Memory

Core used to make them. Yet, once when I was walking through a Swamp, I noticed that my Litter was actively avoiding Frogs. At first, I assumed that the Core I used might have had a Magma Cube's or other insect's memories inside. I made a couple more Litters to test out this theory, and it turned out, all of them were afraid... It could be that the weak Will inside the Concentration Core adapts to its body, and possibly forms instincts based on that. However, I believe it is more

likely that the Core is closer to a conduit that directly links to the Conglomerate Mind behind the Risus. Alternatively, it could be a combination of both ideas. Either way, it proves how Rituals could be the cornerstone puzzle pieces that I can use to one day complete my research - and finally understand it all.
